name: Sailove!
source:
Sakura is the brightest kid at school, pretty much the perfect individual. However, he does have one thing that he is bad at: love. His phobia gets tested daily as he constantly gets confessed to by the girls at school. One day, his classmate Aoba, a fellow outstanding student who has no interest in love, suggested that they pretend to be a couple. They agree to act like the most powerful couple that everyone will idealize.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/12/05/december-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
王子谷樱是学校里最聪明的学生，几乎称得上完美无缺。不过，他也有一件不擅长的事：恋爱。学校里的女生不断向他告白，每天都在考验他对恋爱的恐惧。一天，同样优秀、却对恋爱毫无兴趣的同班同学姬川苍叶提议，两人假扮情侣。他们约定，要扮演一对令所有人憧憬的最强情侣。

（来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/12/05/december-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]）
